title: Home Appliance Repairers
description: Repair, adjust, or install all types of electric or gas household appliances, such as refrigerators, washers, dryers, and ovens.

tasks.text: Bill customers for repair work, and collect payment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Observe and examine appliances during operation to detect specific malfunctions such as loose parts or leaking fluid.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.

tasks.text: Talk to customers or refer to work orders to establish the nature of appliance malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.
Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Refer to schematic drawings, product manuals, and troubleshooting guides to diagnose and repair problems.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Trace electrical circuits, following diagrams, and conduct tests with circuit testers and other equipment to locate shorts and grounds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Replace worn and defective parts such as switches, bearings, transmissions, belts, gears, circuit boards, or defective wiring.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Provide repair cost estimates, and recommend whether appliance repair or replacement is a better choice.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Advise others on issues related to repairs, installation, or equipment design.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Disassemble appliances so that problems can be diagnosed and repairs can be made.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Respond to emergency calls for problems such as gas leaks.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Service and repair domestic electrical or gas appliances, such as clothes washers, refrigerators, stoves, and dryers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of worn mechanical parts

dwas.name: Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Reassemble units after repairs are made, making adjustments and cleaning and lubricating parts as needed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Reassemble equipment after repair.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Record maintenance and repair work performed on appliances.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Test and examine gas pipelines and equipment to locate leaks and faulty connections, and to determine the pressure and flow of gas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Gas leak detection needs physical sensors and access

dwas.name: Inspect gas systems or components to identify leaks or other potential hazards.

tasks.text: Light and adjust pilot lights on gas stoves, and examine valves and burners for gas leakage and specified flame.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Gas leak detection needs physical sensors and access

dwas.name: Inspect gas systems or components to identify leaks or other potential hazards.

tasks.text: Instruct customers regarding operation and care of appliances, and provide information such as emergency service numbers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer product training is relational and situational

dwas.name: Train customers in the use of products.

tasks.text: Contact supervisors or offices to receive repair assignments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment diagnosis aided; hands-on fix is human

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to resolve equipment problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Maintain stocks of parts used in on-site installation, maintenance, and repair of appliances.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Level refrigerators, adjust doors, and connect water lines to water pipes for ice makers and water dispensers, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on leveling of machines with tools

dwas.name: Level machines or equipment.
Connect hoses to equipment or piping.

tasks.text: Observe and test operation of appliances following installation, and make any initial installation adjustments that are necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Set appliance thermostats, and check to ensure that they are functioning properly.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — System checks partly aided by telemetry, still human-verified

dwas.name: Inspect systems to determine if they are operating properly.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Install appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, and stoves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Appliance installation requires physical labor

dwas.name: Install home appliances.

tasks.text: Level washing machines and connect hoses to water pipes, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on leveling of machines with tools

dwas.name: Level machines or equipment.
Connect hoses to equipment or piping.

tasks.text: Clean and reinstall parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, and touch up minor defects on newly installed or repaired appliances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Conserve, recover, and recycle refrigerants used in cooling systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of hazardous materials

dwas.name: Dispose of hazardous materials.

tasks.text: Install gas pipes and water lines to connect appliances to existing gas lines or plumbing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical pipe installation work

dwas.name: Install piping for installation or maintenance activities.

tasks.text: Take measurements to determine if appliances will fit in installation locations, performing minor carpentry work when necessary to ensure proper installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical distance measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Measure, cut, and thread pipe, and connect it to feeder lines and equipment or appliances, using rules and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Install piping for installation or maintenance activities.

tasks.text: Assemble new or reconditioned appliances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.
